title: mirrortimer
summary: MSUI implements the three authored top-center MirrorTimer bars for fatigue, breath, and feign death: first-idle/stable re-state slot ownership, exact colors and captions (including owning-spell names), server-rate client integration, pause/stop handling, world-enter reset, and law-owned 206x26 stacking, fill, border, and UV projection. The renderer contains no local Vector2 geometry; focused and full deterministic checks pass.

openItems.text: SMSG_START_MIRROR_TIMER / SMSG_PAUSE_MIRROR_TIMER / SMSG_STOP_MIRROR_TIMER not in Opcodes.cs and never decoded
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: all three opcodes are strict-decoded and dispatched through MirrorTimerPackets.

openItems.text: No mirror-timer bar UI (colored StatusBar + label + border under the top-center of the screen)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: DrawMirrorTimerFrames renders the authored status texture, black backing, casting-bar border, label, colors, and three-row top-center stack exclusively through MirrorTimerUiLaw.

openItems.text: No client-side countdown integration (value + signed rate per tick)
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-21: MirrorTimerState integrates the signed scale from the last server timestamp, settling exactly on pause and clamping only the displayed bar value.
